note: Item looks, keyed by the 'look' id in content/core/items/*.json. Shapes for the stand-ins live in src/systems/items/item_kit.gd; colours and sizes live here. To use a real model, set 'scene' to a .tscn/.glb path (wearer's back is -Z in the model, 1 unit = 1 metre); the stand-in is then skipped. 'on_back' places the worn item on the chest joint (metres, degrees). See docs/ADDING_ITEMS.md.
